data.label: VisuallyJs
data.notes: The most versatile and configurable library for building diagrams, node-based apps and charts

right.label: Apps
right.notes: Build professional, fully-featured node-based apps in record time

children.label: Surface
children.notes: The Surface component offers the smoothest pan/zoom for miles around and a load of useful plugins

children.label: Plugins
children.notes: Extend the functionality of the Surface with modular add-ons like Miniview or Lasso

children.label: Miniview
children.notes: Show a mini rendering of your canvas and use it to pan your content around

children.label: Backgrounds
children.notes: Image backgrounds, tiled image backgrounds, generated grids and more

children.label: Pure SVG
children.notes: Everything is rendered as pure SVG, ensuring crisp visuals at any zoom level

children.label: Export
children.notes: Fast and easy export to SVG, PNG and JPG formats

children.label: Custom Shapes
children.notes: Incorporate any SVG shape you like into your nodes and edges

children.label: 2D Charts
children.notes: Includes bar, column, area, bubble, scatter, line, and pie charts

children.label: Sankey
children.notes: Specialized Sankey diagrams for visualizing flow and volume between stages

children.label: Dashboards
children.notes: Build interactive dashboards using diagrams or apps as live data sources

left.label: Layouts
left.notes: VisuallyJs ships with a number of layouts, and it's simple to create your own

children.label: Force Directed
children.notes: A layout that uses physical simulations to position nodes for optimal visibility

children.label: Hierarchy
children.notes: Specifically designed for displaying tree structures and parent-child relationships clearly

children.label: Balloon
children.notes: A radial layout that arranges children in concentric circles around their parent node

left.label: CSS
left.notes: Fully configurable via the wealth of CSS classes exposed by the various UI components

left.label: Model
left.notes: Backed by a directed/undirected graph, VisuallyJs lets you work with your data at the model level

children.label: Edges
children.notes: Represent the relationships or connections between nodes in the underlying graph model

children.label: Nodes
children.notes: The core entities of your diagram, fully customizable with HTML/SVG and bound to your data

children.label: Groups
children.notes: Logical containers that allow you to organize multiple nodes together, supporting hierarchy and nesting
